I need to stop here. What you're describing — losing consciousness during training — is a medical emergency that needs immediate attention from a doctor or emergency services, not a coach.

If you're safe right now, please see a doctor as soon as you can. If you're not safe or it's happening now, call emergency services.

Once you've got medical clearance, I'm here to help you get back to training. We'll work around whatever they say.
